text:
maya: Heads up — final UX pass on Prompt Sets & Evals checklist. Need quick eyes on: keyboard nav, screen reader labels, scorecard density, and bulk-approve copy. Can we confirm before ship tomorrow?
design-bot: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz Prompt Sets > Eval Scorecard v4
aj: Quick notes from QA: keyboard focus skips the 'Approve selected' popover on IE11 mode. Not blocking for modern browsers but worth noting.
samir: On copy: 'Approve selected' maybe ambiguous. Suggest 'Approve selected tests' or 'Approve selected prompts' depending on scope.
eli: Accessibility nit: scorecard star rating doesn't have aria-label. Also contrast of warning tint around diff rows is 3.8:1 -> below 4.5.
maya: Good catch, Eli. Samir — prefer 'Approve selected prompt tests'.
karen: :thumbsup: Agree with label specificity. Also we should have an undo CTA in the toast after bulk approve.
aj: Forgot to mention: regression diff inline comments overflow on narrow screens — they hide the action buttons. See screenshot: <link>
samir: Proposed aria snippet:
`````
<button aria-label="Approve selected prompt tests" id="bulk-approve-btn">Approve</button>
```
And aria-live for the toast: `aria-live="polite"`
eli: For screen readers, ensure the diff summary has `role="group"` and `aria-labelledby` pointing to the prompt title. That makes navigation easier.
design-bot: Updated figma with contrast swatches + new copy. Frames: Scorecard / Compact / Mobile.
maya: One last UX: the 'Regressions' badge count — should be announced on expand. Add `aria-atomic="true"` to badge container?
aj: Test plan item — keyboard: tab order through batch select -> approve -> toast undo. Samir, can you add to QA checklist?
samir: On it. I'll add keyboard cases + screen reader checks. Also will include color contrast tests in Lighthouse runs.
karen: Copy for toast: 'Approved 12 prompt tests. Undo' shorter is fine. Make undo a link-style button.
maya: Perfect. If no blockers, I'll merge tomorrow AM. :rocket:
